question: How many days do I have to return an item?
answer: You can return an item within 21 days of its delivery date. The delivery date is the date shown as "Delivered" in your order history; if the carrier recorded no delivery date, the window starts 7 days after the order date. A return request sent on the 21st day counts as on time.

question: How much does it cost to return an item I simply changed my mind about?
answer: A return costs €3.95, which is deducted from your refund. This covers the prepaid label and is the same for every carrier and every country. Alternatively, you can send the item back at your own expense with a tracked service and pay nothing to us, as long as you enter the tracking number in your return request.

question: Can I return a mascara I have opened?
answer: No, you cannot return an opened mascara under normal circumstances. Mascaras are on the list of products that cannot be returned once opened for hygiene and health reasons. However, there is one exception: if the mascara is defective, damaged on arrival, not as described, or caused a confirmed allergic reaction, you can return it even if opened, within the 21-day return window.

question: My parcel is 3 days past its estimated delivery date. What can I do?
answer: Your parcel is considered late since it hasn't arrived 2 days after its estimated delivery date. You can cancel the order from your order history and receive a full refund, including the delivery cost, within 5 business days—you don't need to wait for the parcel to arrive. If the parcel arrives after you've cancelled, simply refuse it or send it back using the prepaid label we'll email you.

question: Which carriers deliver to Belgium?
answer: All four carriers deliver to Belgium: Albatros Parcels, Blue Heron Logistics, Kestrel Freight, and Swift Otter Delivery. You can track your parcel on the carrier's website using your tracking number.

question: Is delivery free for a €30 order?
answer: No, delivery is not free for a €30 order. Delivery is free only for orders of €35 or more per seller. For orders below €35, delivery costs €4.90 per seller in every country.

question: Can I pay by bank transfer?
answer: No, Albert's Marketplace accepts payment by card only: Visa, Mastercard and American Express. We do not accept bank transfers, cash on delivery, cheques or gift cards from other shops.

question: How long after I close my account is my data deleted?
answer: When you close your account, your personal data is deleted within 30 days. However, invoices and payment records are kept for 10 years as required by law.

question: What commission does a seller pay on each sale?
answer: A seller pays a 12% commission on each sale, calculated on the item price and excluding delivery costs.

question: Is the KAO Nivea UV sunscreen gel suitable for oily skin?
answer: Yes, the KAO Nivea UV Deep Protect & Care Gel SPF 50+ is suitable for oily skin. It is a light sunscreen gel that leaves no white cast and is specifically formulated for oily skin types.

question: Combien coûte un retour si j'ai simplement changé d'avis ?
answer: Un retour coûte 3,95 €, qui seront déduits de votre remboursement. Ce tarif couvre l'étiquette prépayée et est identique pour tous les transporteurs et tous les pays. Vous pouvez aussi renvoyer l'article à vos frais avec un service suivi, auquel cas vous ne payez rien à Albert's Marketplace.

question: What is the phone number of customer service?
answer: Albert's Marketplace does not publish a phone number for customer service. Customers contact sellers through Albert's Marketplace only. For questions about your personal data, you can write to our data protection officer at privacy@albertsmarketplace.example.

question: Do you offer gift wrapping?
answer: I don't have information about gift wrapping services at Albert's Marketplace. For details about this service, please contact our customer support team.

question: How long is a password reset link valid?
answer: The password reset link is valid for 1 hour. After that, you would need to request a new reset link.

question: Can I use two discount codes on the same order?
answer: No, you can only use one discount code per order. If you have multiple codes, you will need to choose which one to apply to your purchase.

question: Do you deliver to Switzerland?

answer: Non, Albert's Marketplace ne livre pas en Suisse. Nous livrons uniquement en France, en Allemagne, en Italie, en Espagne, aux Pays-Bas et en Belgique.

question: How much does delivery cost for a €20 order?
answer: Delivery costs €4.90 for orders below €35. Since your order is €20, you will pay €4.90 for delivery.

question: My parcel has shown no movement for 12 days. What can I do?
answer: Your parcel is considered lost since the carrier has shown no movement for 10 days. You can report it from your order page, and we will refund you within 5 business days or send a replacement if the seller has stock, whichever you prefer.

question: How long do I have to report a parcel that arrived damaged?
answer: You have 48 hours from delivery to report a damaged parcel. When you report it, include a photo of the parcel as it was delivered and a photo of the damaged item. The return will be free, and you can choose between a refund or replacement.

question: Can I change the delivery address once my order is in transit?
expected_facts: no longer|cannot be changed|can't be changed|contact the carrier
answer: No, once your order is in transit, the delivery address cannot be changed by Albert's Marketplace or the seller. However, you can contact the carrier directly with your tracking number to see if they can help with address changes.

question: How quickly am I refunded once my return is confirmed?
answer: Once your return is confirmed, you are refunded within 5 business days to the card you paid with. Your bank may take a few more days to show it in your account.

question: I was charged twice. When will the second charge be refunded?
answer: If both charges appear as collected on your statement after 3 business days, you can report the double charge from your order page with a screenshot of your statement. We will refund the second charge within 3 business days of your report.

question: Which cards do you accept?
answer: Albert's Marketplace accepts payment by card only: Visa, Mastercard, and American Express. We do not accept bank transfers, cash on delivery, cheques, or gift cards from other shops.

question: How often are sellers paid?
answer: Sellers on Albert's Marketplace are paid every 14 days by bank transfer, for every order that has been delivered at least 7 days before the payout date, minus commissions, subscription fees, and any refunds. However, if a payout is below €10, it is carried over to the next payout period.

question: What monthly subscription does a seller with 60 sales in a month pay?
answer: A seller with 60 sales in a month pays a monthly subscription of €19. This subscription applies to sellers with 50 or more sales in the month.

question: Within how many days must a seller ship an order?
answer: According to Albert's Marketplace policy, sellers must ship every order within 2 business days of the order.

question: How many drops of the OZNaturals Retinol Serum should I apply?
answer: You should apply two or three drops of the OZNaturals Retinol Serum in the evening on clean, dry skin, followed by a moisturiser. It is recommended to start with two evenings a week and use a sunscreen the next day.

question: Combien de temps ai-je pour retourner un article ?
answer: Vous avez 21 jours à partir de la date de livraison pour retourner un article acheté sur Albert's Marketplace. La date de livraison est celle affichée comme « Livrée » dans votre historique de commandes. Une demande de retour envoyée le 21e jour est acceptée, même si le colis arrive chez le vendeur plus tard.

question: Kann ich per Überweisung bezahlen?
answer: Nein, Albert's Marketplace akzeptiert nur Kartenzahlungen: Visa, Mastercard und American Express. Banküberweisungen sind leider nicht möglich.

question: Do you have a loyalty points programme?
answer: I do not have information about a loyalty points programme at Albert's Marketplace. This is not covered in our help centre pages.
